maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring subscriptions to cloud EDI and supply chain network software, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private retailers, grocers, brands, suppliers, distributors and logistics providers paying for EDI and item data services.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its EDI network and solutions to more trading partners, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: EDI network carries orders, shipments and invoices with retailers; switching means re-onboarding trading partners, recertification and order disruption.
